parsedVerdict.reasoning: Coverage.ts sits in the domain layer, but it uses TypeORM's @Entity() and @Column() decorators. These decorators describe how the class maps to database tables and columns, which is a persistence job that belongs in the infrastructure layer. Because the persistence mapping is built into the domain class, the domain model is tied to the ORM. The rest of the class (the peril, limit and deductible fields and the constructor) is ordinary domain data.
